title: Normalize a clipped signed query and bound the actual added density
statement: For each complete independent attempt, clipping gives E(M+WH)_+=f+b. Rejection returns the SAME normalized law g=(f+b)/(1+B), with TV(g,f)<=B/(1+B). The actual all-speed Gaussian tail gives3.573967442659345e-15 uniformly in finite time. This is an ideal-real approximate law; a finite-cell proposal point is not automatically a conditional target draw.

requires: Actual normalized homogeneous3Dhard-sphere kernel and nonradial source with exact invariants/evaluator/sampler and warrantedD
Acquired FULL-domain weighted row certificateeta199/200including analytic tails, not preview quadrature

provides: ForEH(v)=(f(v)-M(v))/W(v),|H|<=L, proposeG=M+LWnormalized and acceptmax(0,(M+WH)/G). The actual accepted density isg=(f+b)/(1+B), withb=E[-M-WH]_+,B=intb. ThusTV(g,f)<=B/(1+B)<=d/(1+d),d=int[LW-M]_+. Normalization and complete-attempt work are paid; this is not an unnormalized clipped estimator.
assumptions: Arbitrary angular dependence is admitted only for the supplied near-Maxwellian source, exact conserved moments, weighted norm and evaluator. This is approximate continuous output, not exact f_t or a validated binary64/finite-bit sampler. The actual128-output floating cohort had no nonlinear proposals or clipping events and does not validate those laws. The matched full-law lineage won12.1663s versus1.8814s; physical qualification, useful numerical transient accuracy and practical superiority remain unacquired.
